title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention now covers Microsoft Cowork
summary: Hold: Microsoft publishes licensing for the Copilot DLP location, so describing its entitlement as unpublished could mislead budgeting. The briefing also omits the documented date restriction on protected emails and overstates the absence of other Cowork restrictions.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; What's changing; Scope: Who and what
claims.claim: Learn documents one policy location named Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork that covers these experiences.
claims.quote: The **Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork** policy location supports the following conditions and actions:

claims.claim: A matching sensitive-prompt rule prevents Copilot and Cowork from returning a response.
claims.quote: This policy prevents Copilot and Cowork from returning a response when prompts contain sensitive data.

claims.claim: A matching web-search rule blocks external search for that prompt while allowing a response using permitted internal sources.
claims.quote: When a user prompt contains the configured SITs, Copilot and Cowork block external web search as a grounding source and continue to generate the response using allowed internal Microsoft 365 data sources.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure, sensitivity-label rules; Scope: Who and what
claims.claim: Sensitivity-label rules stop Copilot and Cowork using matching files and emails in responses, without an email-date qualification.
claims.quote: A rule configured to protect items with sensitivity labels applies to Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork and supports the following content: ... Emails sent on or after January 1, 2025. ... Calendar invites aren't supported.
claims.fix: Qualify the sensitivity-label coverage statement with: 'For email, this protection covers emails sent on or after January 1, 2025; calendar invites are not supported.' Apply that qualification to the corresponding scope description. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-microsoft365-copilot-location-learn-about#coverage-of-email-and-file-content.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure, response citations
claims.claim: Items excluded by sensitivity-label rules can still appear in response citations.
claims.quote: Identified items still appear in the citations of the response, but Copilot and Cowork don't access or use the content of the item in the response.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure, uploads; Scope; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: DLP does not scan file contents uploaded directly into prompts and checks only typed prompt text.
claims.quote: DLP can't scan the contents of files that you upload directly into prompts, so evaluation of the uploaded file for sensitive data doesn't occur. DLP only checks the text you type into the prompt itself.

claims.quote: Blocking external email isn't yet supported for Cowork.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published licensing for the Copilot and Cowork DLP location.
claims.quote: *Purview DLP for prompts is available to all users of Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'per-user'. Replace the blanket unpublished-licensing statements, including the notes and cost rationale premise, with: 'The Purview service description publishes licensing for the Copilot DLP location: restricting files and emails is included in Microsoft 365 E5/A5, Microsoft Purview Suite/EDU/FLW, Microsoft Defender + Purview Suite FLW, Microsoft 365 E5/A5/F5 Information Protection and Governance, and Office 365 E5/A5. Prompt protection is available to all Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat users. That table does not separately name Cowork, so any Cowork-specific entitlement differences remain unconfirmed.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/microsoft-365-service-descriptions/microsoft-365-tenantlevel-services-licensing-guidance/microsoft-purview-service-description#microsoft-purview-data-loss-prevention-dlp-for-microsoft-copilot and https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/purview-billing-models. Narrow the licensing open question to Cowork-specific differences, rather than whether licensing for the location is published.

claims.claim: No separate meter is documented for the Cowork DLP extension at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Cowork" "DLP" "billing" "meter"'. Read the combined-location article, Purview billing models and Purview service description. No separate meter for the DLP extension found; Cowork usage billing is distinct.

claims.where: Governance controls: first paragraph; Open questions: separate coverage
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a separate switch to exclude Cowork from this combined Copilot DLP location.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Cowork" "DLP" "separate" "switch"'; 'Microsoft Cowork DLP separate disable switch PowerShell Copilot location meter billing charge'. Read combined-location article and New-DlpCompliancePolicy reference; neither documents a separate Cowork exclusion switch.

claims.claim: The sources for this DLP extension document policy evaluation rather than new agent actions.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Purview DLP Copilot Cowork licensing Microsoft 365 Copilot E5 data loss prevention license'; '"Cowork" "DLP" "default" "policy"'. Read roadmap, MC1477182 and combined-location article; none describes new agent actions introduced by this DLP extension.

claims.claim: Without a policy at the combined Copilot location, the sources describe nothing restricting Cowork until someone creates one.
claims.quote: Because the browser tab runs on the user's machine, browser tasks inherit the same conditional access, DLP, and tenant browsing policies you already apply to your users.
claims.fix: Remove 'If you have no policy at that location, the sources describe nothing that restricts Cowork until someone creates one.' The absence of a policy at this particular location does not establish an absence of other restrictions on Cowork.

claims.claim: The prepare action rating fits a launched, automatically extending change that the briefing rates medium risk and says requires policy review.
claims.quote: action: "prepare"; risk: "medium"; status: "launched"; "Existing policies apply automatically; review them."
claims.fix: Set action to 'act-now': the assessment scale assigns that action when a launched change reaches users without admin action, has medium-or-higher risk, and leaves a governance decision to take.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Every monitoring control that the governance checklist directs administrators to check is represented in the controls table.
claims.quote: "Review DLP alerts ... for Cowork prompts that matched." The only controls row is "DLP policy at the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork location" with policy-creation UI and automation.
claims.fix: Remove the After rollout checklist bullet 'Review DLP alerts, which Learn says are supported for this location, for Cowork prompts that matched.' It directs the reader to a monitoring control not represented in the controls table; retain the independently supported statement that alerts are available.
